# PageBreak

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Forces a page break at the current position in the layout flow. When encountered inside a Column or stateful render pass, the renderer moves to a new page before rendering the next element. Has no effect if already at the top of a page.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `ElementBase`. Implements `IStatefulElement`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new PageBreak()
```

## Methods

- [`RenderStateful`](#renderstateful): Asks for a new page unless the cursor is already at the top of one, then reports completion.
- [`ResetState`](#resetstate): Rearms the break so it can trigger again on the next render.
